Nipun presents new collection for Int’l Mother Language Day
2019-02-19T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/news/nipun-presents-new-collection-intl-mother-language-day-1703893

Keeping with the tradition of wearing black and white on 21 February, Nipun has a new collection that reflects the occasion. The collection is made up in hues of black-white and ash. Decorations and embellishments include appliqué, hand embroidery, screen print, and block print. Motifs are mainly in calligraphy, floral and geometric prints.

For more information, visit https://www.facebook.com/nipuncraft/
